The amount of money, in dollars, spent by a customer on one visit to a certain shop is modelled by the distribution $\text{N}(\mu, 1.94)$. In the past, the value of $\mu$ has been found to be 20.00, but following a rearrangement in the shop, the manager suspects that the value of $\mu$ has changed. He takes a random sample of 6 customers and notes how much they each spend, in dollars. The results are as follows.

$$17.60 \qquad 23.50 \qquad 17.30 \qquad 22.00 \qquad 31.00 \qquad 15.50$$

The manager carries out a hypothesis test using a significance level of $\alpha\%$. The test does not support his suspicion. Find the largest possible value of $\alpha$.
